notes: One spec, one render, one bundle: a 4-diagram canvas. `views[0].attempts` lists the three renderable candidates of the shipped line, in order. Every other probe, rejected draft and layout experiment of this round is listed under `abandoned_shapes` with its record label in attempts-log.jsonl; nothing is omitted. This round exceeded the nominal 3-candidate budget and says so in generation.json (blockers) — the frozen engine's 12-node readable-budget warning and the container-box placement drift each forced a re-split.

attempts.label: c1-check
attempts.spec: 2-diagram canvas: L1 context with a 15-node single container, L2 internals with all 9 services in one box
attempts.why: check printed `warning: diagram l1 has 15 nodes / 13 edges, above the readable budget (12/16)`, 14 near-miss cells and 1 ambiguous label owner (l2:e9).

attempts.label: v2-check
attempts.spec: 3-diagram canvas: L1 (11 nodes), L2 all-internals (9 nodes), L1b machine side (7 nodes)
attempts.why: node-budget warning cleared and labels became unambiguous, but the 9-node all-internals diagram still converged four routes on Postgres and produced 28 near-miss cells (l2:e7 at pub/rec, l2:e9 at db).

attempts.label: v3-check
attempts.spec: 4-diagram canvas: L1 context, L2 queue+dispatch, L2b writes into Postgres, L1b machine side
attempts.why: 0 crossings, 0 near-miss cells, 23/23 labels placed with 0 ambiguous owners, no warnings, 10 single-dot routes with 10/10 origins and 0 dot violations.

abandoned_shapes.label: c2-check
abandoned_shapes.spec: same 2-diagram canvas, L2 pinned with `layers` (col0 pgrpc/wapi/pub/rec, col1 q, col2 '',db,reg,jan,ssh)
abandoned_shapes.why: `no obstacle-safe route for jan -> wapi; increase node/layer spacing` — the q->jan->wapi cycle has no corridor once every column is pinned.

abandoned_shapes.label: c2-check-1
abandoned_shapes.spec: 2-diagram canvas with `label_slot: true` on q->ssh and pgrpc->db
abandoned_shapes.why: label_slot moved the ambiguity to `provision job` and raised near-misses from 14 to 22 and crossings from 4 to 9 (bridges).

abandoned_shapes.label: probe-budget-13nodes
abandoned_shapes.why: proves the readable-budget warning is triggered by node count alone (`13 nodes / 4 edges is above the readable budget (12/16)`), which is what forced the 4-diagram split.

abandoned_shapes.label: probe-budget-12nodes20edges
abandoned_shapes.why: duplicate edge pair; only the node-count half of the calibration was needed.

abandoned_shapes.label: probe-enclosed-pad
abandoned_shapes.spec: 2-node container diagram with the legacy `enclosed: true` field
abandoned_shapes.why: the legacy field adds the missing box clearance but makes --check report a `dotted box=...` line, which would claim a dotted boundary this round deliberately does not draw. Not used.

abandoned_shapes.label: probe-drift-demo2-check / -frames
abandoned_shapes.spec: probes/drift-demo2.json — the feature author's own container demo
abandoned_shapes.why: the box is drawn at (18,7) while its members sit at rows 13-16: container geometry does not track the rendered node transform.

abandoned_shapes.label: probe-drift-focus-check / -frames
abandoned_shapes.spec: probes/drift-focus-and-container.json — one container plus a `focus: true` node
abandoned_shapes.why: the focus double border lands exactly on its node, the container box does not land on its members; isolates the defect to the container path.

abandoned_shapes.label: probe-drift-two-diagrams-check / -frames / -overflow-frames
abandoned_shapes.spec: probes/drift-two-diagrams.json — two diagrams, one container each
abandoned_shapes.why: both boxes are painted in their own pre-transform space: the second box lands on the first diagram's rows (row 17 for members at row 26).

abandoned_shapes.label: probe-drift-overflow-frames
abandoned_shapes.why: box size follows the member span while its position does not follow the members, so the drift is positional, not a size bug.

abandoned_shapes.label: pc3 / pc6 (exploratory, unrecorded)
abandoned_shapes.spec: probes/pc3.json (chain with a 3-member box), probes/pc6.json (box around a single member at rank 1..4)
abandoned_shapes.outcome: defect evidence, re-run under the wrapper where a claim depends on it
abandoned_shapes.why: showed that the box's top-left tracks member ranking (col 8 / col 26) while the drawing is centred 25 cells to the right. These two runs were made before the record wrapper was adopted; the equivalent claims are cited from the recorded drift probes above.

abandoned_shapes.label: containment-l1 / l2 / l2b / l1b -check / -view
abandoned_shapes.spec: probes/containment-<id>.json — one diagram per spec, extracted from the shipped spec, rendered at a viewport where it overflows so the box is drawn at pan 0
abandoned_shapes.why: shows which members each box holds and which externals sit outside; also shows the remaining placement defect in L2b/L1b.
abandoned_shapes.record: containment-l1-check, containment-l1-view, containment-l2-check, containment-l2-view, containment-l2b-check, containment-l2b-view, containment-l1b-check, containment-l1b-view

abandoned_shapes.label: containment-*-frames (exit 1)
abandoned_shapes.why: the first pass passed an unsupported `--keep-pan` flag to the record wrapper; kept in the log rather than deleted, the superseded run is `containment-*-view`.

abandoned_shapes.label: canvas-motion-whole-canvas
abandoned_shapes.spec: the shipped spec dumped whole at 171x92 (the canvas extent) for the motion audit
abandoned_shapes.why: at the 77x47 target only the static L1 band is on screen, so the 10 dots of L2/L2b are outside the capture; the whole-canvas dump is the frames capture the animation audit can read. Recorded, and copied into the bundle as canvas-motion-171x92-frames.txt.
